exposure: Multivariable regression models with different combinations of risk factors
cohort: 139 newborns with neonatal seizures and 278 healthy matched controls born between 2001 and 2019 at Emek Medical Center in Israel.
finding: Lower socioeconomic status was a stronger risk factor for neonatal seizures than race or ethnicity, after adjusting for other risk factors.
mod_finding: Assisted mode of delivery was associated with increased odds of neonatal seizures (OR = 2.33).
birth_weight: Lower birthweight was associated with neonatal seizures.
